newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Treasury sees NZ growth of 2.6 pct in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Treasury sees NZ growth of 2.6 pct in 1996/97.

text.p: Treasury on Monday forecast New Zealand's annual average economic growth rate would be 2.6 percent in the year to March 1997.

In its December Economic and Fiscal Update it projected 3.6 percent growth in the 1997/98 year assuming no policy changes. It would fall to 3.1 percent the following year and rise again to 3.5 percent in 1999/2000.

Treasury said monetary conditions are expected to ease gradually in coming quarters as inflation pressures abated because of a cooling housing market, slowing growth in labour costs and slower overall economic growth.
